services.name: Whale Watching Cruise
services.desc: Monterey Bay Canyon is a playground for ocean creatures Duration 2.5- 3 hours About Come observe blue whales, humpback whales, gray whales, killer whales (orcas), dolphins, sea otters, mola molas, seals, sea lions, jellyfish, pelicans, sooty sheerwaters, sea turtles, and much more in their natural environment aboard the nicest and largest boats on Monterey Bay, the Goddess Fantasy. Our on-board Marine Biologists will share their passion to educate and amaze you with facts about these magnificent animals. quotes.text: Great crew and boat, perfect for the family. We went out on the Sea Goddess and the crew was really great. The onboard naturalist gave us a lot of interesting facts and information about the bay and the whales. We saw several whales and one whale followed along near the boat breeching over 100 times! It was amazing to see. I have been on other whale watching trips and these guys are the best! Thanks for a fun time!

That was an experience of a lifetime. We had water-spouts all around us. We had whales swimming in tandem and single animals seemed curious about us on the surface and came up right next to the boat. I've lived in this area for about 10 years and I can't believe it took me so long to check that out.

What an amazing trip we had! 4 beautiful whale spots, with three of them cresting out from the waves at the same time! The staff was so friendly, great with the kids and their questions and full of awesome knowledge. I would highly recommend this tour!

Definitely recommend The Sea Goddess Whale watching tour. The crew was very friendly, helpful and knowledgeable. The boat was very clean. We saw quite a few whales, sea lions, sun fish and jellyfish. Thanks for an awesome trip!

Excellent day on this boat. Very clean. The crew made sure we saw whales and dolphins...a lot of them. The naturalist on board was very knowledgeable and shared a lot of information. My 9 yr old grandson was amazed!
